# TagoBeats

> TagoBeats is the beat catalog and music production studio of Robin Busse, a German audio engineer and music producer based near Leipzig. Robin Busse and TagoBeats are the same person, TagoBeats is his production alias.

## About Robin Busse

Robin Busse is an audio engineer and music producer with 7+ years of experience and a catalog of 300+ tracks, mostly hip-hop, trap and cinematic instrumentals. He is finishing a Bachelor of Engineering in Audio Engineering (Hochschule Mittweida) and develops his own audio plugins and DSP algorithms: TagoClip Pro (soft clipper with the FL soft clip curve, ADAA, a true peak ceiling and level-matched auto gain, https://tagobeats.com/tagoclip-pro), TagoClip (free soft clipper, https://tagobeats.com/tagoclip), TagoPitch (free vocal pitch and formant shifter, https://tagobeats.com/tagopitch) and DubCheck (audio QC software, https://audio-dubcheck.com). All plugins run as AU/VST3 on macOS 11+ and VST3 on Windows.

Services: full music production, mixing, mastering, audio engineering, beat licensing.

Contact: music@tagobeats.com · hello@tagobeats.com

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://tagobeats.com/): Beat catalog selection, plugins, drone photography, about Robin Busse
- [TagoClip Pro](https://tagobeats.com/tagoclip-pro): Paid soft clipper plugin. The FL soft clip curve (measured and cloned) plus two more curves, anti-aliased clipping (ADAA up to 4x), a true peak ceiling as the last stage, mono low end and level-matched auto gain. One-time purchase, 7-day trial without account
- [TagoClip](https://tagobeats.com/tagoclip): Free soft clipper plugin for 808s and drums with the FL soft clip curve, oversampling, delta listening and mono low end, download against email
- [TagoPitch](https://tagobeats.com/tagopitch): Free vocal pitch shifter plugin with separate pitch and formant control, download against email (source: https://github.com/TagoBeats/TagoPitch)
- [Loops](https://tagobeats.com/loops): Free trap and hip-hop loops, download links by email
- [Beat Catalog](https://tagobeats.com/music): Stream, preview and license the full TagoBeats catalog via BeatStars
